verdict.rationale: Channel3 aggregates merchant catalogs and records sales, so a published merchant fee for agent-originated transactions is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never states what merchants pay. The published pricing ($0.007 per credit, 1,000 free credits) covers API usage by developers and agents. The "percentage of the sale price" is a payout to developers, not a published merchant fee, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a merchant, the fees for agent-originated transactions are published — I can price agentic channels without asking sales
